proposal.blind_spot: Store-side coalescing is unmeasured (writes are 30-60% of traffic) and the metrics cannot distinguish latency-bound kernels (fixable with more in-flight loads) from bandwidth-saturated kernels at the roofline (where any rewrite regresses).

rationale.smsp__sass_average_data_bytes_per_sector: LOW -> stores waste sectors: make warp stores contiguous, stage via shared memory, or shrink store dtype (int64->int32) to cut write bytes / HIGH -> stores already optimal: leave store layout alone, only reduce byte volume
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH with DRAM <~85% -> latency-bound: add warps/programs, larger tiles with independent loads, vectorized loads, prefetch / HIGH with DRAM ~92-95% (or LOW with saturated DRAM) -> at roofline: do not rewrite access patterns, only fuse ops or eliminate intermediate materialization to reduce bytes
